messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout feature-X v2 -> prod (canary 10%). Triggered by @Alice T. CI job 4821.

Alice T.: kicking off canary. small traffic, will watch metrics for 10m. known env var change to SERVICE_KMS_ALIAS to new alias redwood-key-v2.

Frank SRE: spotting errors in logs from canary hosts: KMS AccessDenied on decrypt. 403 on kms:Decrypt.

Bob M.: confirming 500s from API gateway. logs: 
```
KMSError: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123:role/redwood-deploy-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd-rotated
```

Carol S.: ugh. That key was rotated last night by the rotation job and the alias moved to a new key ARN. Did we update role perms for the new key?

Alice T.: I thought the deploy read from alias SERVICE_KMS_ALIAS, not direct key. If alias moved, roles should still be fine. checking.

Dave Ops: Paging Erin who owns KMS IAM changes. @Erin Eng can you confirm key access?

incident-bot: @Erin Eng was paged (severity: P1) — acknowledge required.

Erin Eng: ack. looking now. quick check: the new key has a customer-managed key policy that only allows account-root + key creators. The deploy role isn't in the key policy. We missed adding the service role during rotation.

Frank SRE: that explains AccessDenied. Can we revert alias to the old key? That would be fastest.

Alice T.: we have a feature flag kill-switch for feature-X. I'm toggling it off for the canary traffic now. /ff toggle feature-X false --scope canary

Bob M.: command ran. canary traffic now gets the previous code path. 500s decreased a bit but still seeing some 502s in workers where secrets couldn't be decrypted at startup.

Gina PM: visible customer impact: spike in errors for batch inference API since 14:03 UTC. Some customers reported failed jobs. We should count impacted customers and start a status page update.

Carol S.: rolling back the release entirely? We can rollback the config change and redeploy v1. But need to be careful with database migrations (none in this rollout).

Alice T.: I'm initiating rollback of the rollout: deploy-bot rollback rollout/feature-X v1 -> prod.

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress. Instances will be reverted to image sha1: a1b2c3. Expected completion ~3m.

Frank SRE: while rollback is in flight, ops team can patch KMS key policy to include the deploy role. Erin, can you apply minimal update: add Principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/redwood-deploy-role with kms:Decrypt, kms:CreateGrant?

Erin Eng: making the policy change now. doing a dry-run and then apply.

Dave Ops: be careful of grant propagation delay. After update we should test decrypt with aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob ... from a canary host.

Erin Eng: policy applied. verified with aws iam and kms get-key-policy. running decrypt test...

Erin Eng: decrypt test succeeded from deploy role.

Bob M.: I still see a small tail of 500s but most traffic is back to normal. rollback finished according to deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All instances at sha1 a1b2c3.

Alice T.: good. switching feature flag back on for non-canary? keep off until postmortem.

Gina PM: Posting initial incident notice to status page: "Partial outage affecting batch inference; mitigated by rollback. Root cause: KMS key policy missing deploy role after key rotation." Drafting message for customers now.

Frank SRE: next steps: 1) Propose guardrail: rotation job must update key policy with an IAM role mapping step and run integration test that uses deploy role to decrypt. 2) Add pre-deploy check that the SERVICE_KMS_ALIAS resolves to a key with proper policy. 3) Postmortem and timeline.

Carol S.: opening hotfix PR to add pre-deploy check in CI.

Alice T.: handoff: I'm going offline for 20m but Frank will own monitoring and Erin will follow up on the KMS rotation fix. @Frank SRE you have the on-call.

Frank SRE: taking on-call. I'll keep monitoring SLO dashboards and escalate if errors > 0.5% for 15m.

Gina PM: will coordinate customer comms and share list of impacted customers with success team.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042. Severity: P1. Owner: Frank SRE.

Alice T.: thanks everyone. postmortem owners: Frank + Erin. target 48h.

Bob M.: saving logs and snippets to the incident channel. linking: https://logs.internal/redwood/streams/4821?kms=accessdenied

Carol S.: FYI we should also audit the key rotation runbooks. I remember a step that warns about key policy changes but it's not enforced.

Erin Eng: will add enforcement and a smoke test to rotation pipeline. Also will write a small script to validate alias->key policy includes deploy role.

Frank SRE: closing here for now. will update incident ticket when we have the postmortem.

Gina PM: customer update posted at 14:38 UTC.

Alice T.: last note: no DB changes, no data loss. impact was service availability for certain jobs.

Frank SRE: last check: error rate back to baseline. marking this thread resolved but keeping incident open for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 acknowledged by Frank SRE.
